entities.name: Easter Bombings and Economic Collapse
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The 2019 Easter Sunday bombings killing 269, Gotabaya Rajapaksa's election, the catastrophic 2022 economic crisis (worst since independence), the Aragalaya protest movement storming the presidential palace, and Ranil Wickremesinghe's stabilization.
